comparison: Perfect agreement on claims C2-C4, C17-C22 regarding two morphologically distinct EHT cell types. Both evaluations rate as SUPPORTED with strong endorsement of the imaging evidence and quantitative analysis. Peer reviewers explicitly praise the confocal microscopy and 2D-cartography approaches.

Perfect agreement on claims C23-C25 regarding Podxl2 partitioning in HE cells and EHT initiation. Both evaluations rate as SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers implicitly accept these observations as part of the polarity-related findings without raising concerns.

Perfect agreement on claims C5, C26-C34 regarding Runx1's role in polarity regulation. Both evaluations rate as SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers describe the dt-runx1 approach as 'elegant' and accept the accumulation of polarized HE cells as evidence, though both note the mechanism remains somewhat inferential.

Agreement on claims C6, C35-C42 regarding Pard3ba expression and spatial correlation. Both evaluations rate as SUPPORTED. However, peer reviewers note 'No direct evidence for their role in EHT is presented,' accepting the descriptive/correlational data while acknowledging mechanistic limitations.

Agreement on claim C7 regarding signaling crosstalk. Both evaluations rate as UNCERTAIN. OpenEval notes the claim implies bidirectional communication not directly demonstrated; peer reviewers similarly state 'No direct evidence for their role in EHT is presented,' accepting correlation but questioning mechanistic proof.

Strong agreement on claims C8-C9, C46-C52 regarding ArhGEF11 function and intercalation. Both evaluations rate as SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers accept the genetic approaches and morphometric analysis without challenge, noting 'excellent' imaging data quality. OpenEval R7 includes C45 which peer R5 does not explicitly address.

Agreement on claims C43-C44 regarding FRAP measurements of Jam3b dynamics. Both evaluations rate as SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers explicitly affirm junctional recycling data as supporting the main claims. OpenEval notes high biological variability requiring cautious interpretation.

Agreement on claims C53-C54 regarding differential effects of morpholino versus CRISPR on junctional dynamics. Both evaluations rate as SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers accept these findings as part of overall junctional dynamics evidence. OpenEval notes C54 shows only 'small tendency' with weaker statistical support.

Agreement on claim C45 regarding Rock2b expression changes in dt-runx1 conditions. Both evaluations rate as SUPPORTED. OpenEval explicitly evaluates C45 with qRT-PCR data; peer reviewers accept this as part of the broader ArhGEF11/cytoskeletal regulation findings without specific comment.

OpenEval evaluates claims C1, C10-C16 as SUPPORTED background/contextual knowledge from literature. No corresponding peer review evaluation found, as peer reviewers typically focus on novel findings rather than established context.
